mapper.sql: SELECT h.id, h.code, h.name, h.group_id, g.name AS group_name, h.longitude, h.latitude, h.boundary_coords, h.description, h.status, h.device_count, h.del_flag, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time, CASE h.status WHEN 1 THEN '监测中' WHEN 2 THEN '停测中' WHEN 3 THEN '已完结' ELSE '' END AS status_name FROM hazard_point h LEFT JOIN hazard_point_group g ON g.id = h.group_id AND g.del_flag = '0' WHERE h.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hazard_point ( code, name, group_id, longitude, latitude, boundary_coords, description, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{name}, #{groupId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{boundaryCoords}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE hazard_point SET name = #{name}, group_id = #{groupId}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, boundary_coords = #{boundaryCoords}, description = #{description}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: UPDATE hazard_point SET code = CONCAT(LEFT(code, 75), '#DEL#', id), del_flag = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'

mapper.update: UPDATE hazard_point SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE hazard_point SET device_count = device_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE hazard_point SET device_count = GREATEST(device_count - #{delta}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE h.status = #{status} AND h.del_flag = #{delFlag} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hazard_point WHERE del_flag = '0'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hazard_point WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hazard_point WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
